newsitem.title: USA: Playboy Q2 aided by entertainment, catalog.
newsitem.headline: Playboy Q2 aided by entertainment, catalog.

text.p: Playboy Enterprises Inc, reporting higher fiscal second quarter earnings and revenues Tuesday, cited improved results in its entertainment and catalog groups and in international publishing.
However, revenues of its flagship Playboy magazine declined five percent in the period, reflecting a 12 percent decline in advertising pages and lower newsstand revenues.
It said the magazine published two strong-selling issues in the year-ago second quarter.
Playboy said it expects advertising pages for the fiscal third quarter to be up eight percent from a year earlier.
In the entertainment group, Playboy TV was the strongest contributor, with revenues up 26 percent in the second quarter, ended December 31.
The Critics' Choice Video and Playboy catalogs were responsible for a 25 percent rise in the catalog group's quarterly operating income. Revenues rose 12 percent.
International publishing revenues rose, principally due to the acquisition of an additional 45 percent interest in the Polish edition of Playboy magazine.
